concepts.def: A precise step-by-step method for solving a problem.
Ways to express an algorithm before coding.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Problem Solving & Programming — a core area of A-Level Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Problem Solving & Programming brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Problem Solving & Programming.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
